tools.name: search_digest
tools.description: Search the public digest of HL7 standards discussions. Returns at most 20 items, each with every claim's evidence record and canonical_url — no summary text. Use get_digest_item for one item in full.

tools.name: get_digest_item
tools.description: One digest item in full: each claim (question, outcome, impact, stage, next step) with its own evidence record, plus HL7 Jira statuses and canonical_url.

tools.name: get_jira_status
tools.description: Up to 50 HL7 Jira keys: status, resolved, resolution, last_verified with its jira_verified evidence record, lifecycle stage, source_url (HL7 Jira) and the canonical_url of public items that cite it. "applied" is not "published".

tools.name: validate_bundle
tools.description: Validate a synthetic Da Vinci PAS Submit Bundle with the ImOnFHIR validator. Synthetic payloads only. Never send real patient data. Findings describe a synthetic Bundle. Body cap 2 MB, 10 calls per minute.

tools.name: compare_igs
tools.description: Compare two implementation guides, each "packageId#version": one guide at two versions (version diff) or two guides (stack compare). findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "explain_finding" is 1207 chars, far longer than this server's median (228). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
